title: Alpha release and distribution — agent-panel evaluation

panel_protocol.limitation: Simulation instrument only; not a substitute for live release deployment or signed cryptographic tags.

inter_rater_agreement.agreement_notes: All three panel roles converged independently on approval with minor findings. Convergence centered on byte-for-byte packaging reproducibility (identical SHA256 across repeated runs), complete GitHub Action commit-SHA pinning, non-publishable crate firewalls, deterministic SBOM/checksum generation, and truthful claim boundaries.
convergence_vectors: Byte-for-byte reproducible source tarballs via header normalization
100% 40-character commit-SHA pinning on external GitHub Actions
Strict non-publishable crate enforcement across all 30 workspace crates
Deterministic release rehearsal and packaging test suite passing 100%
divergence_vectors: Evaluation of future binary strip options vs symbol preserving debug info
Granularity of base image digest pinning in container definitions

panel_recommendations: Retain byte-level tarball reproducibility invariants across all packaging tool updates.
Keep action commit-SHA pinning automated and verified via check_workflow_hardening.py.
Maintain empty publishable packages list until formal release candidate criteria are satisfied.
